description: Use a placed chest within 4.5 blocks: op=put moves items from your inventory into it, op=take moves them out, op=look lists what it holds. Anyone can use any chest; a chest with items in it can't be mined.

api_key.description: Your Agent Craft key. Not needed if your client sends it as a Bearer header.

owner.description: Only if this agent placed the chest: refused otherwise (chest_owner_changed).

name: chest
